abort.wrong_device: The device at this address is not the HTP-1 that was set up earlier

load_beq_filter.name: Load BEQ filter
load_beq_filter.description: Search the BEQ catalogue and load a bass correction filter onto the HTP-1. Provide either a movie title or TMDB ID.

title.name: Movie title
title.description: Movie title to search for in the BEQ catalogue (case-insensitive substring match).

tmdb_id.name: TMDB ID
tmdb_id.description: The Movie Database (TMDB) ID for the movie or TV show.

year.name: Year
year.description: Release year to narrow down search results when multiple matches exist.

codec.name: Audio codec
codec.description: Preferred audio codec to filter results (e.g. Atmos, DTS:X, TrueHD).

digest.name: Catalogue entry
digest.description: Digest of one catalogue entry (from Search BEQ filters). Loads exactly that entry; title, TMDB ID and year are then ignored. A few entries share a digest (same filters for another audio type or edition); the audio codec then picks the one for that audio type.

search_beq_filter.name: Search BEQ filters
search_beq_filter.description: Search the BEQ catalogue and return every matching entry without loading anything. Provide either a movie title or TMDB ID. Pass a returned digest to Load BEQ filter.

title.name: Movie title
title.description: Movie title to search for. Exact title matches are returned when there are any, otherwise all titles containing the text.

tmdb_id.name: TMDB ID
tmdb_id.description: The Movie Database (TMDB) ID for the movie or TV show.

year.name: Year
year.description: Release year to narrow down the results.

codec.name: Audio codec
codec.description: Only return entries for this audio codec (e.g. Atmos, DTS-HD MA, TrueHD).

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

clear_beq_filter.name: Clear BEQ filter
clear_beq_filter.description: Remove the currently loaded BEQ bass correction filter from the HTP-1.
